days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 154 P with delivery on day 10.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 128 P, delivery on day 10, please?
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway: 117 P with delivery on day 10.
Thank you, we are getting close. 115 P and delivery on day 8 works for me.
Thank you for your offer. I can do 115 P with delivery on day 4.
